question: Is the cache-reuse advantage (M65/MS-98 zero-target; MS-96/97/99 few-shot) specific to OlmoEarth, or does it hold for other spatial Earth foundation models when their embeddings are cached under the identical protocol? Presto (pixel time-series, 0.8M params) is not a like-for-like architecture, so MS-87 does not answer this.

candidates_in_order.name: Clay v1/v1.5
candidates_in_order.why: spatial ViT MAE, native Sentinel-2 input, permissive licence; closest like-for-like
candidates_in_order.contract: S2 bands mapped to Clay's expected band set; 4 timesteps embedded per timestep then mean-pooled to one 768-like grid unless the model natively accepts a stack (record which)

candidates_in_order.name: AlphaEarth Foundations (Google)
candidates_in_order.why: a shipped embedding PRODUCT (64-d annual fields on Earth Engine) — the most direct 'cache product' comparator
candidates_in_order.contract: requires Earth Engine access; annual embedding, no event timing; registered as product comparison, not like-for-like

candidates_in_order.name: Prithvi-EO-2.0
candidates_in_order.contract: HLS 6-band mapping from S2; sensitivity only

identical_protocol.cache_grid: C x 32 x 32 tokens per 128 px tile (patch 4 equivalent). If the FM's native patch differs, embeddings are bilinearly resampled to 32x32 and the channel dim is passed to EmbDecoder(cin=C) (already supported: 'Generalize emb arm channel dim').
arms: P4-style decoder on the second FM cache (zero-target, Sen12 8 folds, 3 seeds)
few-shot A0/A1 on that cache with the same PT-0 manifests (china/chimanimani first, then 8 confirmatory regions)
identical_protocol.comparators: P2 raw UNet3D and OlmoEarth P4 from the sealed runs; no re-running of OlmoEarth arms
identical_protocol.metrics: positive-tile macro IoU (primary), tie-correct AP, FP-matched IoU

verdict_rules.general_principle: second FM cache beats raw P2 in >= 6/8 Sen12 regions AND its A1 beats A4w in >= 6/8 -> claim broadens to 'Earth embedding caches' (paper identity: product-agnostic protocol)
verdict_rules.olmoearth_specific: second FM cache fails either rule -> claim stays OlmoEarth-specific; report honestly; the gap OlmoEarth minus second FM becomes a finding about representation quality, not about the protocol

forbidden: tuning the second FM's decoder recipe differently from P4
claiming generality from Clay alone if AlphaEarth is not run — Clay closes 'like-for-like', AlphaEarth closes 'product'
cost: one embedding pass over 6,834 Sen12 tiles per FM on GPU1 + 24 decoder runs (8 folds x 3 seeds) + few-shot (~1 h)
